viewing_check: Read Coleman model number and date code on the founts (200A/220/201, month-year stamp), check Tilley model (X246B stamped on the base/top), globes intact, pumps and generators, count carriage lamps and look for maker marks (JN&S, Lucas, Kempthorn), dents, missing glass, burner/wick present.
